item_id.description: A clip of a screen recording.

keyframe_ms.description: The time between two keyframes, 50 to 1000 ms. Default 100.

size.description: Pixels of the frame, 8 to 128. Default a fortieth of the frame height, at least 16.

smoothing_ms.description: Time constant of the smoothing, 0 to 2000 ms; 0 follows the raw path. Default 150.

visible.description: false removes the cursor of the clip. Default true.
